panel.title: Control panel
data.hint: Back up or remove SuperCli's local conversations and memory. Project files and API keys are never deleted here.
data.exportHint: Downloads conversations, memory, goals and UI preferences. API keys, accounts, caches and checkpoints are excluded.
data.importHint: Accepts a safe or full SuperCli ZIP. After restart it replaces the matching data and creates a rescue copy.

data.importReady: Import prepared. Restart SuperCli to apply it.
data.confirmSessions: Permanently delete all conversations? Project files, settings and API keys remain untouched.
data.confirmMemory: Permanently clear global and project AI memory? Conversations, project files and API keys remain untouched.
workflow.rewindDone: Message ready to edit or send again.
workflow.rewindHint: Return to just before this message and place it in the composer. Later messages are permanently removed.
workflow.rewindWhyHint: A short reason helps the model avoid repeating the rejected approach.
workflow.rewindReason: What should the model do differently?
workflow.rewindPermanent: This edits the current conversation. The selected message and everything after it will be permanently removed.
workflow.rewindFilesHint: {c} checkpoint(s), {n} file(s). Conflicts stop the entire rewind.
workflow.rewindConflict: File rewind stopped because these files changed later
workflow.restoreFilesHint: File changes were rewound. You can restore the complete version produced by the agent.
workflow.filesRestored: The agent's file version was restored.
workflow.profileHint: Only this bounded local file is appended for the active model family. No extra model call.
undo.learnHint: A short reason helps the agent avoid repeating the same mistake.
sandbox.allowConfirm: Allow the agent to read, search and modify files outside the active project? Sensitive Windows system folders remain blocked.
set.resetAllHint: Removes every managed key above; providers and API keys stay untouched.
set.hint: value · source — same knobs as the TUI /settings panel, stored in config.toml.
app.sound: Play a sound when a run finishes

prov.keepKey: saved key is loaded for editing
prov.keyLoadFailed: Saved key could not be shown; leaving this field empty will keep it.
prov.warn.typeUnclear: The API type could not be determined conclusively; it was saved as OpenAI-compatible. You can change the type while editing.
prov.warn.scanTimeout: {n} was added, but it did not finish listing models within {c}, so no models are known yet. If it is just slow, press Rescan; the provider works as soon as it answers.
runtime.title: Model servers
runtime.hint: Passive status check. Refresh never starts an inference or loads a model.
runtime.switchFirst: Switch model before disabling the active provider.
acct.title: Codex accounts
mcp.portableHint: Drop one self-contained package folder with manifest.toml into supercli-data/mcp. It moves with SuperCli and starts only when the agent needs it.
goal.noneHint: Create one for work that spans several steps or sessions.
goal.title: What should be accomplished?
goal.abandonConfirm: Abandon this goal? Its history will remain saved.
goal.verificationWaiting: Complete or skip every open step before verification.
goal.verificationReady: Check the finished work against the definition of done and record concrete evidence.
goal.verificationFailed: Verification failed — more work is required
goal.finishBlocked: Finish every step and record a successful verification first.
goal.sideHelpPurpose: It is a persistent plan for work spanning multiple messages or sessions.
goal.sideHelpAgent: The agent sees the active goal and open steps in every turn, and can update steps and notes as it works.
goal.sideHelpFinish: After every step is finished, the result must pass a concrete verification. Only then can you or the agent explicitly close the goal.
goal.sideHelpNoBackground: It does not start background work or extra model calls by itself.
goal.sideEmptyHint: Use it for work that should survive more than one message.
usage.noSession: Start or select a session to collect persistent usage statistics.
usage.contextEmpty: No context snapshot has been recorded yet.
telemetry.title: Performance telemetry
telemetry.empty: Use this build for a few turns to collect timing samples.
telemetry.offTurnNote: titles, summaries, indexing, vision — this app run
telemetry.signal.aux_heavy: Helper inference (navigator, draft, reflection, compaction) eats a visible share of each reply; moving it out of the reply would shorten the wait.
telemetry.bottleneck.model: The model backend is the limit
telemetry.signal.collect_more: A few more replies will make this diagnosis more reliable.
telemetry.signal.model_bound: The CLI is out of the hot path; backend or hardware changes will have the largest effect.
telemetry.signal.cli_overhead: Client-side preparation is measurable and worth profiling further.
telemetry.signal.many_steps: The agent uses many model rounds per reply; batching or clearer tool results may help.
telemetry.signal.tool_failures: Some tool calls fail; removing those retries can save complete model rounds.
telemetry.signal.model_failures: Provider calls failed or were canceled; inspect endpoint stability and timeouts.
telemetry.signal.low_cache: Prompt-cache reuse is low; keep the system/tool prefix byte-stable.
telemetry.signal.slow_persist: Session persistence is slower than expected, although it does not block inference.
cost.cacheUnknown: No separate cache rate is known; cached input uses the regular input rate in this estimate.
price.title: Rates & manual override
price.hint: USD per 1M tokens for this exact provider/model pair.
price.cacheHint: Use 0 when the provider does not publish a separate cache rate.
price.identityMissing: A provider and model are required before a manual rate can be saved.
price.removeConfirm: Remove the manual rate for this provider and model?
about.desc: Single-binary AI coding agent with portable data. This GUI is a thin front-end over the same engine the TUI drives.
about.rebindHint: Click a key to rebind it.
data.exportFullHint: Portable ZIP with conversations, memory, goals, provider keys, Codex accounts, MCP/skills, user tools and prompt profiles. It contains readable secrets, so store it securely.
context.pruneThreshold: old tool results may be shortened
context.compactHint: Summarizes the older model-visible context. The complete conversation remains saved and searchable.
context.compacted: Context compacted: {n} older messages replaced by a summary.
context.selectSession: Open a conversation before compacting its context.
context.busy: Wait for the current answer to finish before compacting.
setting.orchestrator.label: Orchestrator
setting.orchestrator.desc: Delegate substantial work adaptively, always, or never.
setting.allow_all.label: Access outside the project
setting.allow_all.desc: Allow file operations beyond the active project; sensitive system folders remain blocked.
setting.discard_previous_reasoning.label: Discard previous reasoning
setting.discard_previous_reasoning.desc: From the next turn, omit reasoning from completed replies. The transcript and required tool-call blocks remain. Off by default.
setting.thinking.label: Thinking mode
setting.thinking.desc: Enable explicit thinking for local models that support a soft switch.
setting.navigator.label: Task navigator
setting.navigator.desc: Choose whether requests are routed as chat, advice, or coordinated work.
setting.stable_toolset.label: Stable tool set
setting.stable_toolset.desc: Keep the tool catalog unchanged during a session to preserve the KV cache.
setting.cache_prompt.label: Prompt cache
setting.cache_prompt.desc: Ask compatible local lllama.cpp servers to reuse their KV prompt cache.
setting.darwin_parallel.label: Parallel Darwin variants
setting.darwin_parallel.desc: Run best-of-N candidate agents concurrently when the backend can handle it.
setting.task_parallel.label: Parallel delegations
setting.task_parallel.desc: Let independent delegated tasks run at the same time.
setting.memory_briefing_tokens.label: Startup memory budget
setting.memory_briefing_tokens.desc: Maximum tokens used by the memory briefing at session start.
setting.task_max_steps.label: Worker step limit
setting.task_max_steps.desc: Maximum number of model turns a delegated worker may take.
setting.task_max_tokens.label: Worker token limit
setting.task_max_tokens.desc: Maximum total token spend for one delegated worker.
setting.task_model.label: Worker model
setting.task_model.desc: Optional model or provider/model used for delegated work.
setting.compact_model.label: Compaction model
setting.compact_model.desc: Optional model or provider/model used only for context summaries.
setting.noop_gate.label: Skip unchanged batch runs
setting.noop_gate.desc: Avoid an unnecessary model call when an identical batch request has no new changes.
setting.preflight_repo.label: Repository preflight
setting.preflight_repo.desc: Add a compact repository-state briefing to the first message and delegated tasks.
setting.draft_verify.label: Draft and verify
setting.draft_verify.desc: Draft file changes with a worker, then verify them before applying the result.
setting.draft_verify_max_rounds.label: Draft revision limit
setting.draft_verify_max_rounds.desc: Maximum revise rounds before the coordinator takes over.
setting.verify_commands.label: Verification commands
setting.verify_commands.desc: Commands used as objective checks for draft verification, separated with semicolons.
setting.default_model.label: Default model
setting.default_provider.label: Default provider
workflow.queueHint: The queue survives app restarts and waits for you to resume it.
prov.chooseHint: Choose a ready integration or configure a custom endpoint.
prov.searchPlaceholder: Search providers, e.g. OpenAI or Ollama…
prov.customHint: OpenAI, Anthropic, or a local server
prov.autoDetectHint: Auto detect probes only the models endpoint — no inference. Responses API remains an explicit choice.
update.title: Updates
update.hint: Check when you choose. Downloading and installing are separate actions.
update.downloaded: Update downloaded and verified. Ready to install.
update.installed: Update installed. Restart SuperCli when your current work is finished.
update.unsupported: No update package is available for this platform.
update.downloadFailed: Could not download and verify the update.
instructions.title: User instructions
instructions.description: Save a preferred way of working. Instructions are attached to every new message, but cannot replace higher-priority model or provider rules.
instructions.enabledHint: Turning this off removes the instructions from the next message and costs no context.
instructions.name: Preset name
instructions.contentPlaceholder: Example: answer in English, preserve document formatting, and ask before deleting files.
instructions.applied: Active — this preset will be attached to the next message.
instructions.notApplied: Inactive — select a non-empty preset and enable instructions.
instructions.cost: No hard limit. Longer instructions use more context and may make responses take longer. They do not trigger an extra model call.
instructions.longCost: This is a long preset — it will be attached to every message while enabled.
update.busy: Finish or stop the current run and workers before installing the update.
setting.orchestrator_model.label: Coordinator model
setting.orchestrator_model.desc: Optional model or provider/model for coordinating delegated work. An empty value uses the main model.
setting.fallback_models.label: Fallback models
setting.fallback_models.desc: Ordered list of fallback provider/model references, separated with semicolons.
setting.fallback_cooldown_seconds.label: Fallback cooldown
setting.fallback_cooldown_seconds.desc: Seconds to skip a backend that failed before returning any output.
